sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Use the owner's why-containment rule (feedback.direction-duplicates): count unique titleWords from an open item's title found in the current slice's Why, divided by that title's unique content-word count. Use threshold 0.6. Add a helper alongside titleWords; keep existing title Jaccard behavior unchanged. Read current Why through slicer show. List matches once under Likely duplicates before file-overlap and other items, preserving the digest budget and omission count. Retain existing fallback on failed digest reads. Update behavior documentation and add the changelog through slicer.
